name: Pritam Kumar Bishwas
summary: Full-Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications and integrating AI/LLM tools using React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, and Python. Experienced in REST APIs, authentication, payments, and database-driven features, with a record of debugging production issues on live fintech and e-learning platforms.
summaryShort: Full-Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web apps and AI-native tools with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Python.

highlights: Built and maintained full-stack features for live fintech and e-learning platforms using React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Developed reusable, responsive UI components with React.js, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, and Tailwind CSS, improving UI consistency and development speed by [X]%.
Improved page load performance by [X]% through code splitting, lazy loading, and API response caching.
Designed and optimized REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, reducing response times by [X]% through database query optimization.
Troubleshot and resolved critical production issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver features from requirements to release.
Managed the backend and frontend (Admin Panel) of the FortuneTalk application, ensuring robust and efficient server-side operations.
Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB to support frontend functionalities.
Implemented new features and enhanced existing ones, improving user engagement and satisfaction by 30%.
Collaborated with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic using React.js, Redux, Webpack, and Material-UI.
Optimized database queries and maintained data integrity with MongoDB, improving data retrieval speed by 15%.
Used Git for version control and managed code repositories.
Maintained and enhanced web applications using PHP, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and MySQL.
Fixed critical bugs and refactored existing code, improving code efficiency by 30%.
Mitigated bot-driven spam and fraudulent activity by 20% through targeted backend fixes and anti-abuse measures.

projects.title: Gurukul
projects.summary: Full-stack e-learning platform covering course discovery, enrollment, online learning, books, videos, events, dashboards, payments, and secure content access.
highlights: Developed a full-stack e-learning platform supporting course discovery, enrollment, online learning, books, videos, events, user dashboards, and secure content access.
Built responsive and reusable interfaces using Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for course listings, learning modules, dashboards, cart, and account management.
Implemented Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) with Next.js to improve page performance, SEO, and content discoverability.
Implemented SEO best practices including dynamic metadata, semantic HTML, optimized page structure, and search-engine-friendly course and content pages.
Developed RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js for authentication, course management, cart and order processing, payments, certificates, and role-based access control.
Integrated MySQL for managing users, courses, orders, certificates, and learning content, with optimized queries and efficient database operations.
Implemented payment workflows, webhooks, course access validation, and cron jobs for automated course expiry and access management.
Used Redux Toolkit and RTK Query for centralized state management, API caching, data synchronization, and frontend performance optimization.

projects.title: Momentify
projects.summary: Responsive Vue.js frontend with reusable components, REST API integration, search, filtering, and personalized content.
highlights: Developed a responsive frontend application using Vue.js, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS with reusable components and responsive layouts.
Implemented modular Vue.js components and state management to support scalable feature development and maintainable application architecture.
Integrated REST APIs for dynamic data retrieval and implemented search, filtering, and personalized content functionality.
Optimized frontend performance through efficient component rendering, lifecycle management, API handling, and reusable component architecture.

projects.title: Algo Trader
projects.summary: Trading interface presenting market data, trading signals, and portfolio information through interactive dashboards.
highlights: Developed a responsive trading interface using Vue.js, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS for presenting market data, trading signals, and portfolio information.
Built interactive dashboards and reusable components to display real-time market data and trading-related insights.
Integrated RESTful APIs for retrieving market data and supporting order execution and portfolio management workflows.

projects.title: AI-Powered Resume Builder
projects.summary: Full-stack application that generates ATS-friendly resumes and tailored application materials.
highlights: Architected a FastAPI backend integrating Groq/OpenAI LLMs for resume tailoring, summary generation, and cover letter creation based on target job descriptions.
Engineered a "Fact Guard" system that intercepts LLM responses and rejects hallucinated metrics or experiences not present in the user's data.
Built an AI analysis pipeline that scores resumes for ATS compatibility, identifies skill gaps, gives actionable feedback, and generates interview questions.

Implemented document parsing with PyMuPDF and python-docx to extract text from multi-column PDF and DOCX uploads, and export engines (Jinja2, xhtml2pdf, python-docx) for ATS-compliant PDF and DOCX output.
Designed a privacy-first data flow with MongoDB (Motor), keeping parsed resumes in memory and persisting only user-initiated versions.
Developed the frontend with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, and Radix UI, with AI agents interacting only with a centralized JSON schema while templates handle layout.

projects.title: Chat AI
projects.summary: Full-stack ChatGPT-style application where users chat with multiple LLMs, with streamed responses, persistent conversation history, and a responsive interface.
highlights: Built a ChatGPT-style web app with a React, TypeScript, and Redux Toolkit frontend and a FastAPI backend, streaming LLM responses in real time over Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Designed a provider abstraction layer that switches between OpenAI (GPT-4o), Groq (LLaMA 3), and a mock provider for local testing.
Implemented chat management (create, rename, delete, switch conversations) with MongoDB persistence, plus RTK Query for data fetching, optimistic updates, and message retries.
Developed a responsive UI with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI, Markdown rendering with syntax highlighting, and FastAPI middleware for request timing, request IDs, and CORS.

projects.title: Napuf
projects.summary: Web application with authentication, product management, shopping cart, and secure server-side form handling.
highlights: Developed web application features using PHP, CodeIgniter, MySQL, and Bootstrap, including authentication, product management, and shopping cart functionality.
Implemented secure authentication and form protection using CSRF tokens, password hashing, session management, and server-side validation.
Designed responsive user interfaces using Bootstrap 5, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript for consistent cross-device experiences.
Integrated backend functionality with MySQL for structured data management and CRUD operations across application modules.

projects.title: FortuneTalk Application
projects.summary: Communication and astrology platform with call, chat, video, insights, e-commerce, and learning sections, powered by third-party integrations for OTP, payments, and video calls.
highlights: Engineered robust REST APIs (GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE) for the backend, enabling seamless data transactions and increasing data retrieval efficiency by 50%, significantly reducing user wait times.
Added features such as Call, Chat, Video Call, Free Insights, E-commerce, and Learning Section to enhance user engagement and functionality.
Integrated third-party APIs including SMS Gateway (OTP), astrology API (Free Insights), call (Knowlarity), Video Call (Zegocloud), and Razorpay (Payment gateway) to extend application capabilities.

story: I’m a full-stack engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications. I work across the stack — React.js, Next.js, and Vue.js on the front end, Node.js, Express.js, and TypeScript behind them — with a focus on REST APIs, authentication, payments, and database-driven features.
Lately I’ve also been building AI-native tools — a multi-LLM chat application and an AI resume builder — with FastAPI, Python, and the Groq and OpenAI APIs.

Much of that work has been on live fintech and e-learning platforms, debugging production issues and tuning API, query, and front-end performance. I care about the details that don’t show up in a screenshot: fast loads, sensible semantics, and code the next developer can read.

values.title: Accessible by default
values.body: Semantic HTML first, ARIA where it earns its keep, and keyboard paths tested before the UI is called done.

values.title: Performance is a feature
values.body: Budgets, profiles, and real devices — fast is a decision made on every commit, not a cleanup sprint.

values.title: Clarity over cleverness
values.body: Code is read far more than it is written. I optimise for the next developer, including future me.
